```yaml
name: Update pnpm lockfile on Dependabot PR

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-lockfile:
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch Dependabot metadata
        id: dependabot-metadata
        uses: dependabot/fetch-metadata@v2
        with:
          github-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: latest
          run_install: false

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"
          scope: "@team-mirai"

      - name: Update pnpm lockfile
        run: |
          # Get the directory from Dependabot metadata
          DIRECTORY="${{ steps.dependabot-metadata.outputs.directory }}"
          
          # If no directory is specified, default to root
          if [ -z "$DIRECTORY" ]; then
            DIRECTORY="."
          fi
          
          # Update the lockfile in the specific directory
          echo "Updating lockfile in directory: $DIRECTORY"
          pnpm install --lockfile-only --dir "$DIRECTORY"
          
          # Check if there are changes
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            echo "Lockfile updated successfully"
            git config --global user.name 'dependabot[bot]'
            git config --global user.email 'dependabot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
            git add .
            git commit -m "chore: update pnpm-lock.yaml" || echo "No changes to commit"
            git push origin HEAD:"${GITHUB_HEAD_REF}" || echo "Push failed, likely already updated"
          else
            echo "No changes detected in lockfile"
          fi
```
